scripts.check: bun run generate:check && bun run check:scripts && bun run check:sdk && bun run check:desktop && bun run lint:server && cargo test -p popcorn-server --lib core::
scripts.test: bun test scripts/release-version.test.ts apps/desktop/tests apps/site/tests && cargo test -p popcorn-diagnostics && cargo test -p popcorn-server --lib core::
scripts.lint:server: bun scripts/lint-server.ts && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml -p popcorn-server --check && CLIPPY_CONF_DIR="$PWD/apps/server" cargo clippy -p popcorn-server --lib --bins -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: bun run check:scripts && bun run check:sdk && bun run --filter @popcorn/desktop typecheck
